SELECT f.id, f.friend_id AS userId, u.username, COALESCE(p.nickname, u.username) AS nickname, u.credit, f.create_time AS createTime FROM friend f JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.friend_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 1 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friend WHERE status = 1 AND ((user_id = #{a} AND friend_id = #{b}) OR (user_id = #{b} AND friend_id = #{a}))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friend_request WHERE from_user_id = #{from} AND to_user_id = #{to} AND status = 0

SELECT r.id, r.from_user_id AS fromUserId, r.to_user_id AS toUserId, r.status, r.create_time AS createTime, u.username AS fromUsername, COALESCE(p.nickname, u.username) AS fromNickname, u.credit AS fromCredit FROM friend_request r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.from_user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE r.to_user_id = #{toUserId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
